objective: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with double vision, difficulty climbing stairs, and upper limb weakness.

patient_info.History: 1-month history of double vision, difficulty climbing stairs and weakness when brushing her hair; worse after activity, better after rest.

physical_exam.Neurological_Examination: Right ptosis worsening with sustained upward gaze; reduced proximal upper-limb strength; normal reflexes and sensation.

test_results.Electromyography: Decremental response on repetitive nerve stimulation

objective: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with fever, productive cough and pleuritic chest pain.

patient_info.History: 3 days of fever, chills, cough with rusty sputum and sharp right-sided chest pain on breathing in.

physical_exam.Chest_Examination: Dullness to percussion and bronchial breath sounds over the right lower zone.

test_results.Chest_X-Ray: Right lower lobe consolidation with air bronchograms

objective: Assess and diagnose the patient with polyuria, polydipsia and weight loss.

patient_info.History: Two weeks of constant thirst, passing urine very often, losing 5 kg without trying; today nausea and abdominal pain.

physical_exam.General: Dry mucous membranes, fruity odour on breath.
